limits.en: Up to 3 channels, 10 scheduled posts per channel, 1 user, 100 saved ideas, 30-day analytics history.

keyLimits.en: Priced per connected channel, not per user: $5/month or $60/year per channel. Unlimited scheduled posts, 1 user, advanced analytics, hashtag manager.
Priced per connected channel: $10/month or $120/year per channel. Unlimited users, approval workflows, custom access permissions, branded reports.

cautions.en: Buffer bills per connected social channel, not per seat: adding more channels multiplies the monthly cost even on a single-user account. Volume discounts apply above 10 channels.

capabilities.en: Schedules and publishes posts across major social networks from one calendar.
AI Assistant to help draft post copy and repurpose content ideas.
Built-in analytics/Insights dashboard and a shared team content calendar.
API access for custom integrations, with request limits that scale by plan.

limitations.en: Free plan capped at 3 channels and 10 queued posts per channel, with no analytics beyond 30 days.
Per-channel pricing means teams managing many brand accounts pay proportionally more than flat per-seat tools.

reason.en: Direct competitor in social media scheduling with a broader per-seat pricing model.
Similar visual-first social scheduling tool aimed at small teams and creators.
More enterprise-oriented social media management suite covering the same core scheduling need.

unknowns: Exact volume-discount rate for channels beyond 10 not confirmed with a specific number.
